import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
import matplotlib.patches as p
ax.add_patch(p.Circle((0,0),0.8,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.add_patch(p.Circle((0,0),0.35,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(0,0,"axle+disc",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(p.Rectangle((0.7,0.5),0.3,0.2,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(0.85,0.75,"caliper",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([0.85,1.5],[0.5,1.2],'k-')
ax.text(1.5,1.2,"dead-man cable",fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(p.Polygon([[ -0.9,-0.6],[-0.6,-0.6],[-0.75,-0.3]],closed=True,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(-0.75,-0.85,"park tooth pin",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(p.Circle((-1.3,0.6),0.25,fill=False));ax.add_patch(p.Circle((0.5,-1.1),0.25,fill=False));ax.add_patch(p.Circle((-0.2,1.2),0.25,fill=False))
ax.text(-1.3,0.6,"wheel",ha='center',fontsize=7);ax.text(0.5,-1.1,"wheel",ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig("sketch.png")
